notes.title: Shroomer Demo update 0.3.2
notes.content: [p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implemented herb cutting, added different harvestable herbs, added sickle[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented drying of herbs, food and shrooms[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new mushroom with a unique mechanic [/p][/*][*][p]Added bubbles to cooking pot when boiling[/p][/*][*][p]Added vignette when walking and running to reduce motion sickness[/p][/*][*][p]Added rare sound effects in forest area at night[/p][/*][*][p]On android SpaceWarp is now turned on during loading to reduce lag[/p][/*][*][p]Important objects now have their dedicated sockets on player or basket[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]When scaring birds they now directly fly away from player and then find suitable spot to land[/p][/*][*][p]Papyrus texture so the text area blends better with rest of the model[/p][/*][*][p]Quest time limits are now set dynamically on quest start[/p][/*][*][p]Sounds for pockets and socketing objects[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Fixed bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where pillow could fall through the map when player was far away[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where inventory freeze effect would play on quest accept[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where sometimes finished quest couldn’t be grabbed from basket top[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that potion would spill when drinking, causing much faster depletion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed foveated rendering setting not saving correctly on PCVR[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed physics materials on knife so now they make correct sounds and effects[/p][/*][*][p]And few minor bugs[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Implemented herb cutting, added different harvestable herbs, added sickle
Implemented drying of herbs, food and shrooms
Added a new mushroom with a unique mechanic
Added bubbles to cooking pot when boiling
Added vignette when walking and running to reduce motion sickness
Added rare sound effects in forest area at night
On android SpaceWarp is now turned on during loading to reduce lag
Important objects now have their dedicated sockets on player or basket

tags.balance_change: Quest time limits are now set dynamically on quest start

tags.bug: Fixed bug where pillow could fall through the map when player was far away
Fixed bug where inventory freeze effect would play on quest accept
Fixed bug where sometimes finished quest couldn’t be grabbed from basket top
Fixed that potion would spill when drinking, causing much faster depletion
Fixed foveated rendering setting not saving correctly on PCVR
Fixed physics materials on knife so now they make correct sounds and effects

notes.title: Shroomer Demo Update 0.2.6
notes.content:
[p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added inventory mechanics to boxes, bowls, and other objects[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced mold and rot mechanics for mushrooms, which can block or enable quest delivery depending on requirements[/p][/*][*][p]Added slugs to some mushrooms that block quest delivery[/p][/*][*][p]Added new ambient and event sounds throughout the forest[/p][/*][*][p]Added new interactable objects across the scene[/p][/*][*][p]Added new secrets[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented liquid transfer and blending mechanics — any container with liquids can now be spilled and mixed[/p][/*][*][p]Added a way to fill the cooking pot in the loading room[/p][/*][*][p]Added new detailing to the forest area[/p][/*][*][p]Added butterfly variations[/p][/*][*][p]Added variations of bugs and other fauna to mushrooms[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ladders can now be dismounted using teleport[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery portal now features new VFX and SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Pre-cut mushrooms are now edible and can be cooked[/p][/*][*][p]Birch tree/wood gradient 

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Fixed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where incorrect items weren’t returned properly at the delivery portal[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing Czech localization in the graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error caused by socketing the money pouch[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the effect on a magic mushroom wouldn’t play[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the tree tapper effect would play even if the bottle wasn’t filling up[/p][/*][*][p]Money duplication with fast grabbing[/p][/*][*][p]Parus bird could fly through portal with delivered items resulting in item being stuck in portal[/p][/*][*][p]Watertap particles would play at game start[/p][/*][*][p]Water footstep sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Spider yoyo effect[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [p]Added inventory mechanics to boxes, bowls, and other objects[/p]
[p]Introduced mold and rot mechanics for mushrooms, which can block or enable quest delivery depending on requirements[/p]
[p]Added slugs to some mushrooms that block quest delivery[/p]
[p]Added new ambient and event sounds throughout the forest[/p]
[p]Added new interactable objects across the scene[/p]
[p]Added new secrets[/p]
[p]Implemented liquid transfer and blending mechanics — any container with liquids can now be spilled and mixed[/p]
[p]Added a way to fill the cooking pot in the loading room[/p]
[p]Added new detailing to the forest area[/p]
[p]Added butterfly variations[/p]
[p]Added variations of bugs and other fauna to mushrooms[/p]
[p]Ladders can now be dismounted using teleport[/p]
[p]Delivery portal now features new VFX and SFX[/p]
[p]Pre-cut mushrooms are now edible and can be cooked[/p]

tags.bug: [p]Fixed bug where incorrect items weren’t returned properly at the delivery portal[/p]
[p]Added missing Czech localization in the graphics settings[/p]
[p]Fixed an error caused by socketing the money pouch[/p]
[p]Fixed issue where the effect on a magic mushroom wouldn’t play[/p]
[p]Fixed bug where the tree tapper effect would play even if the bottle wasn’t filling up[/p]
[p]Parus bird could fly through portal with delivered items resulting in item being stuck in portal[/p]
[p]Watertap particles would play at game start[/p]
